# lcd.pen

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Get / Set the current pen style.

```lua
local pen = lcd.pen(pen)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pen` | integer | yes | a binary mask or one of the values SOLID, DOTTED or DASHED |

## Returns

pen (integer)

## Examples

```lua
lcd.pen(PEN_DOTTED)
lcd.drawLine(0, thresholdY, w, thresholdY)   -- dotted threshold line
lcd.pen(PEN_SOLID)                            -- back to solid for the rest
```
